_comment: THE string table. Every user-visible label lives here with both languages
side by side, so the two can never drift: a wording change is one row edited
twice, in view of each other, rather than two files edited weeks apart.
docs/strings-data.js is GENERATED from this by scripts/build_web.py. Never
edit that file. The .ics generator reads this same table, so a feed and the
screen cannot disagree about what an event is called.
Strings are added as the feature that needs them is written -- authoring both
columns at the moment of writing costs almost nothing, while retrofitting
English later means re-reading every string and recovering its context.
Pre-existing Arabic elsewhere in the app is migrated in Phase 4.
Validation (scripts/strings.py) rejects a row missing either language, so a
half-translated key cannot ship silently as a blank on screen.
